name: lmsbox-backend
description: LMS Box on Firebase: rules, emulator config, seed and tests. See CONTRACT.md. Never deploy without --only.

scripts.test:rules: node scripts/emu.mjs emulators:exec --project demo-lmsbox --only firestore "node --test test/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e:student: node scripts/emu.mjs emulators:exec --project interactive-media-2a1fc --only auth,firestore "node test/e2e-student.mjs"
scripts.test:functions: node scripts/emu.mjs emulators:exec --config firebase.fn-test.json --project demo-lmsbox --only auth,firestore,functions "node --test functions/test/formativ.test.js"
scripts.test:e2e:dashboard: node scripts/emu.mjs emulators:exec --project interactive-media-2a1fc --only auth,firestore,functions "node test/e2e-dashboard.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e:kurztest: node scripts/emu.mjs emulators:exec --project interactive-media-2a1fc --only auth,firestore "node test/e2e-kurztest.mjs"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions && npm run test:e2e:student && npm run test:e2e:kurztest && npm run test:e2e:dashboard
scripts.test:hko:rules: node scripts/emu.mjs emulators:exec --config firebase.hko-test.json --project demo-hko --only firestore "node --test test/hko-rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:hko:upload:emu: node scripts/emu.mjs emulators:exec --config firebase.hko-test.json --project demo-hko --only firestore "node --test test/hko-upload.emu.test.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e:hko: node scripts/emu.mjs emulators:exec --config firebase.hko-e2e.json --project interactive-media-2a1fc --only auth,firestore "node test/e2e-hko-student.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e:hko-dashboard: node scripts/emu.mjs emulators:exec --config firebase.hko-e2e.json --project interactive-media-2a1fc --only auth,firestore "node scripts/seed-hko.mjs && node scripts/hko-upload.mjs --emulator --build test/fixtures/hko-build && node test/e2e-hko-dashboard.mjs"
scripts.test:hko: npm run test:hko:rules && npm run test:hko:upload && npm run test:hko:upload:emu && npm run test:e2e:hko && npm run test:e2e:hko-dashboard
